sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the maintenance Procedures 
P1, 
which must be performed every five years or when the leakage water through the shaft seal is excessive and the 
interval time of stop start of the turbine leakage water pump become short as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block.

The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Ashraf Saber, tested by eng. Alsayed Ibrahim El ashmony, 
accepted by general director eng. Abd elghaffar Osman, approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abd elbaset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل وصيانة مؤهلة 
 يحمل الموظفون فئة معرف السلامة المناسبة،

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety Helmet.
Intake and draft tube gate in closed position
Complete water passage is dewatered
Guide vane mechanism open totally
Hydaulic control system depressurised

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Dismantling (DWG no: 
8621720)
Open spiral casing main hole

Install scaffolding above 
turbine runner

Open access (4 covers) in 
inner turbine cover

Dismantle the water supply 
pipe, part no. 32

Remove the screws, part 
no. 14 from seal casing ring 4 (top ring)

Take out the two-parted 
casing ring 4

Remove the draw spring, 
part no. 19

Remove the segments of the 
carbon sealing ring, part no. 16 including pressure spring, part no. 18, and 
position pin, part no 19

Repeat steps 5 to 8 for 
dismantling of sealing ring 3

Remove the water supply 
ring 2

Repeat steps 5 to 9 for 
dismantling the sealing ring 1 (bottom ring)

الاتجاه كما هو مبين للتفكيك
انتباه

Make sure, that the upper 
carbon sealing segments are installed in ring 3+4, and the lower carbon sealing 
segments are installed in ring 1
ملحوظة:

Make sure the bad carbon 
segments must be repair with a new segments
